records.name: Family Child Care Advisory Council
records.summary: A council for people who run family child care, which means caring for children in their own homes. Members join through an online form on the council's website.
records.what_you_do: Fill out the membership form on the council's website to join, then ask the council which member activities are open to you.

first_step.how: Fill out the membership form linked from the Become A Member button on fccadvisorycouncil.org
first_step.basis: A membership form is the clear way in, but the site does not say who qualifies or what members get.

records.notes: The homepage has a mission link, an events link and a membership form, but no text that says in plain words what the council does and no dated events (the Upcoming Events heading has no listings). The summary rests on the group's name and a link to a national accreditation for educators, so confidence is low. The only date is a 2024 copyright footer, which is not counted as evidence; status is probably_active only because the site works with no dates. Social icons point to the website builder's own accounts, so none are recorded. A contact page exists at fccadvisorycouncil.org/contact. The contact person on the IRS filing is not published on the site, so not recorded. Search budget not used on this group.

records.name: The Fathering Circle
records.summary: A peer support group for men who are raising a young person. Men 17 and older meet every Monday evening to talk with other men in the same position.
records.what_you_do: Come to the Monday evening circle and talk with other men who are raising a young person.

schedule.text: Peer support circle every Monday, 6 to 7:30 pm

locations.label: Philip E. Lindy House (Drexel Dornsife Center)

first_step.how: Use the contact page on thefatheringcircle.com to ask how to sign up for the Monday circle before you come
first_step.basis: Sessions are for eligible men, and the site does not say how to sign up or what a first visit is like.

records.notes: Newest dated item is a post about a partnership with The Wilma Theater, dated June 7, 2026 on the group's homepage (the post itself was not opened separately). The page gives no zip code, so none is recorded, and no cost is shown. The X (Twitter) link on the site was not recorded because it was not checked. The Wilma Theater is named as a partner (see leads_only).

records.name: Ian-Yae's in Touch
records.summary: A nonprofit that helps people experiencing homelessness and families in underserved neighborhoods. Its Community H.U.B. offers meals, a clothing closet, a food pantry, haircuts, and computer use, and volunteers help with year-round street outreach.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer with the year-round street outreach team, or ask about helping at the Community H.U.B.

first_step.how: Use the Contact Us page on ian-yaesintouch.org to ask how to volunteer with street outreach or the Community H.U.B.
first_step.basis: Programs are named but the site shows no schedules, and the only way in is a contact page.

records.notes: The only dated text on the site is a 2013 copyright footer, which is not counted as evidence, and no dated news or events appear. Status is probably_active only because the site works with no dates, so a phone call or the group's Instagram page should confirm it is still running. No email or phone is printed on the site. The IRS address (2524 N 27th St, 19132) is not confirmed on the site, so no location is recorded. Youth mentoring, community cleanups and a Christmas event are named with no details. The site's donate button shows a default amount of 20 dollars; not recorded.

records.name: Linked Family Services
records.summary: Helps parents and caregivers keep their families steady. It offers parenting classes, essential goods, family wellness programs, and a mobile care unit.
records.what_you_do: Take a parenting class, ask about the essential goods available to you, or volunteer through the group's volunteer page.

schedule.text: Office hours: Monday and Thursday 12 to 7 pm, Friday 10 am to 3 pm (program times not listed)

first_step.how: Call 215-703-7756 during office hours and ask about the next parenting class and which essential goods you can get
first_step.basis: The site lists a phone number and office hours and welcomes parents and caregivers, though it does not describe what a first visit is like.

records.notes: Newest dated item is a 2026 mention: the Philadelphia City Council acknowledged the group during Black Maternal Health Week 2026. The page gives no month, so last_sign_of_life is left out. The schedule is office hours only; program times are not listed. The page's email link goes to contact@linkedfamily.org while the printed address is admin@linkedfamily.org, so confirm which one answers before publishing. The footer reads 2018 (copyright, not counted). No tag fits parenting classes exactly, so parent_playgroups is the closest choice. Named programs: Tiny Essentials Relief Hub, Mobile Care Unit, Bridge and Anchor Youth Initiative. A second Pads and Pencils event is named with no date.

records.name: National Alliance of Women Veterans
records.summary: A group that speaks up for women who served in the military. It runs learning, healing, and empowerment work, paying special attention to women who were hurt by military sexual trauma. Women veterans can join, volunteer, or sponsor the work.
records.what_you_do: Join as a member, volunteer, or come to the 20th Anniversary Tribute on October 24, 2026.

schedule.text: 20th Anniversary Tribute on October 24, 2026: breakfast and networking 9 to 11 am, panel and lunch 11 am to 2 pm, ceremony at 3:45 pm

locations.label: Mount Airy Church of God in Christ (tribute venue)

first_step.how: Email info@nawvinc.org to ask how to attend the October 24, 2026 tribute or how to volunteer
first_step.basis: Women veterans join automatically as members, and the site gives an email address and a contact form.

records.notes: Newest dated item is the 20th Anniversary Tribute, listed for October 24, 2026 (upcoming, so it is evidence of current activity). The site says panelists register by October 10 through Eventbrite; the year is not stated there. The founding year appears three different ways on the site (1993, 1996, 2000) and the founder's name varies, so neither is recorded. Some page text reads like unfinished draft copy. No veterans tag exists, so veterans is recorded in audience.community. No phone number is printed.

records.name: Rho Chi Society, Beta Lambda Chapter
records.notes: The batch website, www.pharmacy.temple.edu, did not resolve (DNS error), so the batch website was not recorded. The school's own site at pharmacy.temple.edu (3307 N Broad St, the same address as the IRS filing) was read: it does not mention Rho Chi, a chapter, or any honor society, and its only honor-type item is a Dean's List link with no details. Rho Chi is a student honor society, and such chapters usually admit students by invitation. That is general knowledge, not something a page said, so the hide is a judgment call with low confidence. Re-check if Temple publishes a chapter page that shows a public way in. The school's 2026 events (an October 30 conference, a November 5 anniversary event, a November 9 First Gen group meeting) are not this group's events.

records.name: Strawberry Mansion Learning Center
records.summary: An afterschool learning center in the Strawberry Mansion neighborhood that helps local kids and teens with homework and offers mentoring.
records.what_you_do: Kids and teens get homework help and mentorship at the center. Ask the center how adults can mentor or help out.

first_step.how: Use the Contact Us page on strawberrymansionlearningcenter.com to ask how to sign a child up for homework help
first_step.basis: The site describes the programs but gives no schedule, enrollment steps or start dates, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: No dated event or news item is on the site. The footer reads Copyright 2021, which is not counted as evidence. Status is probably_active only because the site works with no dates. The site also says the center needs a building renovation to expand. The IRS address (2946 W Dauphin St, 19132) is not confirmed on the site, so no location is recorded. An alternate name appears in a board bio: Strawberry Mansion Community Learning Center. A board member's bio names a tennis association as providing youth tennis camps for the center (see leads_only).

records.name: Battle 4 Children Charities
records.notes: Held back: no summary, categories or interests. The batch website field held an email address at a personal internet provider domain, so it was not recorded as the group's own. One search (Battle 4 Children Charities Philadelphia) found no official site. Results say the group began in 2010 as a Battle of the Christian Bands music contest, became a 501(c)(3) in 2015, and is also spelled Battle4Children Charities. The mission (funding trauma therapy for children) and the event details come from a promotional newsletter post (https://anthonycirillo.substack.com/p/coming-up-tomorrow-at-2-pm-eastern-c83) and a local event listing, not from the charity itself, and the posts are undated, so no summary is written. A free fundraiser at a Willow Grove church was listed for a Saturday in February (year not seen), and one listing names a second charity as a co-beneficiary (not checked). Next step: find the charity's own page or its IRS Tax Exempt listing, then decide whether its events are open to the public.

records.what_you_do: Ask about the workshops or programs through the contact form, or by phone, to find out which one fits you.

first_step.how: Call 267-270-5609 or use the contact form on beyondtheexteriorinc.org to ask which workshop or program fits you
first_step.basis: The site lists program areas and a contact form, but no schedules, costs or sign-up steps.

records.notes: No dated event or news item is on the site. blocked.note: HTTP 500 on every try, both the www host and the bare domain

notes: Budget: both WebSearch calls used (cap reached). 15 WebFetch calls in total. No broad rate limiting was seen. Ujima Friends returned HTTP 500 on every try (see blocked). The batch website for Rho Chi did not resolve, but the school's own site at pharmacy.temple.edu was read. Searches went to Rosebuds Mentoring Program (its website field held the word President) and Battle 4 Children (its website field held an email address). The Society of Ibero-Latin American Medical Professionals had a name in its website field and got no search, so it is held back as unknown. Contact people named on the IRS lists were not published on the group sites and were not recorded. IRS addresses are recorded as locations only where the group's own site printed the same address (Linked Family Services, Delivering Services With Love, Fathering Circle, and the National Alliance of Women Veterans event venue). Verdict counts: publish 13, hide 1, out_of_area 1. Held back (publish with no summary, or status unknown): New Woodstock, Rosebuds, Society of Ibero-Latin American Medical Professionals, Ujima Friends, Battle 4 Children. The Rho Chi hide is a judgment call, explained in its record.
